status: natural re-blocking (product-owner decision 2026-10-05, docs/DECISIONS.md item 1), painter jasna2035
note: Inside a moving Funitel cabin of the Priehyba-Chopok line (type-reference: the Parnitha Funitel interior; cabin shape and colour from the real Jasna cabins; the view from the real line down to Demanovska dolina and Liptov). Camera ~1.6 m high in the cabin, looking across at the long window wall (about 2.5 m away); horizon y ~370 (the far Liptov plain); the padded bench under the windows stands on the floor at y ~760 (~185 px per metre there). Perspective s(y) = (y - 371) / 644, a close interior. Left: the downhill end panel with its door (back to Priehyba); centre: three big window panes over the padded bench; right: the cabin scheme poster on the panel beside the closed sliding doors (exit on arrival); the summit station of Chopok comes into view in the right window pane (arrival hotspot). The tourist stands holding the ceiling rail in front of the left pane.

S68.arrival.reason: the upper part of the right window pane, where the Chopok summit station with the round Rotunda comes into view up the line

S68.ambient 2.reason: the framed cabin scheme poster on the panel between the windows and the sliding doors

S68.TURISTA.reason: the tourist Milos stands in front of the left window pane, holding the ceiling rail
